cards.text: King David is running from his own son Absalom, and he's gone up the Mount of Olives barefoot and weeping (2 Samuel 15:30). Just past the summit, somebody is waiting for him. It's Ziba, the servant of Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son and King Saul's grandson (2 Samuel 9:6, 9).

cards.question: Ziba is standing there waiting for David. What has Ziba brought with him?

answers.text: Saddled donkeys loaded with food and wine
A band of armed men from Benjamin
A message from Hushai in Jerusalem

cards.text: And Ziba did NOT pack light: two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred clusters of raisins, a hundred summer fruits and a skin of wine. Friend, my biggest batch ever in the Millers' kitchen was four dozen cookies, and I needed a NAP.

cards.question: David asks Ziba why he has all this. Ziba says the donkeys are for the king's household to ___, and the wine is for anyone who gets ___ in the wilderness.

cards.text: Ziba's got it all worked out, with bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat. Then David asks, 'Where is your master's grandson?'

cards.question: True or false: Ziba says Mephibosheth stayed in Jerusalem because he expects Israel to give him back his grandfather's kingdom.
After hearing Ziba's report about Mephibosheth, David tells Ziba, 'All that belongs to ___ is now yours!'

cards.text: Ziba says, 'I humbly bow before you.' I'd bow too, friend, because the best thing anybody ever handed me in that junk drawer was a takeout menu.
As King David comes near Bahurim, a man from the family of Saul's house comes out. His name is Shimei son of Gera, and let me tell you, he did NOT bring donkeys full of bread.

cards.question: What does Shimei son of Gera do as he comes toward David?

answers.text: Bows low and asks for mercy
Warns him that Absalom is coming

cards.text: Shimei keeps throwing stones at David and his servants, even with the troops and mighty men right there on David's right and left, and he yells, 'Get out, get out, you worthless man of bloodshed!' One man taking on a whole army, friend, that's a chihuahua barking at a garbage truck.

cards.question: Shimei says the LORD has paid David back for the blood of the house of ___ and handed the kingdom to David's son ___.

cards.text: Abishai son of Zeruiah, David's nephew (1 Chronicles 2:16), has heard ENOUGH. He says, 'Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king?'

cards.question: Abishai wants to deal with Shimei. What does he ask David to let him do?

answers.text: Go over and cut off his head

cards.question: David answers Abishai, 'What have I to do with you, O sons of Zeruiah?' What reason does David give for leaving Shimei alone?

answers.text: The LORD may have told Shimei to curse him
Shimei is protected by the house of Saul
Killing Shimei would turn the people away

cards.question: True or false: David tells his men that his own son, his own flesh and blood, is trying to take his life.
With the curses still coming, what does David hope the LORD might do for him?

answers.text: Repay him with good for the cursing
Strike Shimei down right on the spot
Turn Absalom's heart back toward him

cards.text: So they keep walking, and Shimei walks right along the ridge across from them, cursing, throwing stones and flinging dust at David. Friend, I spent YEARS buried in dust in a junk drawer, and even I think that's too much dust.

cards.question: True or false: When David and the people with him finally arrive, they're still full of energy.

cards.text: And there, David refreshes himself. That's where we'll leave it for now, friend, because this story is a LONG way from over.
